rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" bh_autotools_dev_update
autoreconf -v
export CFLAGS="`echo $CFLAGS | sed 's@-Werror=format-security@@g'`" export CXXFLAGS="`echo $CFLAGS | sed 's@-Werror=format-security@@g'`"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" $AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --enable-threads \ --disable-rpath \ --disable-nls \ --disable-openmp \ --disable-native-java \ --disable-silent-rules
